items.problem: P13 exact-candidate release verification and terminal Handoff are absent.
items.impact: No authoritative released v1.3 input exists for post-release operations.
items.proposedNextVersion: P13 closure only; no product semantic change
items.acceptance: P13 full gate, independent reviews, 75 acceptance items and Handoff all pass on the recorded candidate.

items.problem: Release authorization, immutable tag and deployment manifest are absent.
items.impact: Production baseline and change scope cannot be frozen.
items.acceptance: Signed authorization and deployment manifest identify SHA, tag, environment, images, migrations, flags and rollback target.

items.problem: Production metrics/log/trace/query access is not connected.
items.impact: SLO, alerts, drift, feedback and incident decisions cannot use authoritative observations.
items.acceptance: Every required monitor has a tested query, retention/freshness, redaction and authorized tenant scope.

items.problem: Operations, rollback, security, cost and on-call owners are unassigned.
items.impact: Alerts and high-risk responses have no accountable human authority.
items.acceptance: Named owners accept alert, escalation, rollback and communication duties for the deployed environment.

items.problem: Production SLO, error budget and alert thresholds are unapproved.
items.impact: Burn, freeze and recovery decisions cannot be measured consistently.
items.acceptance: Approved targets, windows, exclusions, burn rates and manual action conditions are versioned.

items.problem: No authorized post-release outcome, incident, cost, drift or recovery-drill dataset exists.
items.impact: Continuous-improvement recommendations cannot be production-evidence based.
items.acceptance: Approved observation/drill window yields redacted, exact-release evidence with integrity checks.
